tidymst: Read and Analyse NanoTemper Microscale Thermophoresis Exports

Source: R/tidymst-package.R
tidymst-package.Rd

Read the Excel exports written by NanoTemper's MO.Affinity Analysis software (MST traces, capillary scans, dose-response and fit results) into tidy data frames, and analyse them: recompute normalised fluorescence (Fnorm) from traces, fit Kd and Hill binding models, and convert responses to delta Fnorm or fraction bound.
